description: Schema for updating a core service type. Core service types are used to detected core services

required_ports.description: The required ports for this core service type, if any

optional_ports.description: The optional ports for this core service type, if any

provider.description: To indicate whether the provider is a core service. Default value is true which means provider is a core service

priority.description: Each IP/workload is identified for 1 core service type and they are ordered by priority
